about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A34: lunches (wraps, filled flatbreads, boreks, burgers, quesadillas, bento, rice-paper rolls, budget bowls, egg lunches).

recipes.title: Beef Kofta Flatbread Wrap
recipes.summary: Spiced beef kofta in warm flatbread with tomato, onion and a garlic yoghurt sauce.
steps: Mix the beef, onion, half the garlic, cumin, coriander, parsley and salt and shape into 8 finger-shaped koftas.
Fry in the oil over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through (75°C).
Stir the remaining garlic and the lemon juice into the yoghurt.
Warm the flatbreads, spread with the yoghurt, add koftas and tomato and roll.
notes: Food safety: cook beef kofta to 75°C with no pink until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Eat within 3 days if chilled promptly; reheat until steaming hot.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Roast Pumpkin and Chickpea Wrap (Vegan)
recipes.summary: Cumin-roasted pumpkin and chickpeas with tahini sauce and rocket in a tortilla.
steps: Roast the pumpkin and chickpeas with the oil, cumin and paprika at 210C for 25 minutes until the pumpkin is tender and the edges are crisp.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice and water into a pourable sauce.
Warm the tortillas and spread with the tahini sauce.
Fill with the roast mix and rocket and roll tightly until sealed.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge; pack the rocket separately.
Contains gluten and sesame.

recipes.title: Egg and Chorizo Torta (Mexican Sandwich)
recipes.summary: Scrambled egg with spiced chorizo, refried-style black beans and avocado in a toasted roll.

items: 200g canned black beans, drained and mashed

steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 4 minutes until crisp and cooked through, then pour in the beaten eggs.
Stir for 2 to 3 minutes until the egg is fully set.
Warm the mashed beans in a small pan for 3 minutes until hot.
Split the rolls and toast them in a dry pan until golden, then fill with the beans, egg mix, avocado, tomato and lime juice.
notes: Food safety: cook chorizo until the fat runs and no pink remains until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only).  Cook the egg until fully set; eat the same day or chill within 1 hour and keep below 5C for 24 hours.
Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Tuna Salad Wrap with Avocado
recipes.summary: Flaked tuna, avocado, cucumber and lemon yoghurt in a wholemeal tortilla.
steps: Mix the tuna, avocado, yoghurt, lemon juice, cucumber and spring onion until just combined.
Warm the tortillas briefly so they fold without cracking.
Pile the spinach and tuna mix down the centre.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
notes: Food safety: cook canned tuna only from a freshly opened can until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Keep below 5C and eat within 24 hours if packed; discard if left out for over 2 hours.
Contains fish, gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Fish Finger Sandwich
recipes.summary: Crisp baked fish fingers with tartare sauce and lettuce in buttered white bread.

items: 300g firm white fish fillet, cut into 6 fingers

steps: Dust the fish in flour, dip in egg and press into the panko, then place on a tray brushed with the oil.
Bake at 220C for 15 to 18 minutes, turning once, until golden and the fish flakes easily (63°C).
Mix the mayonnaise, gherkin and lemon juice.
Butter the bread, fill with lettuce, fish fingers and tartare sauce and cut in half.
notes: Food safety: cook fish to 63°C until opaque and flaking until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Eat the same day; chill within 1 hour if packing and keep below 5C.
Contains fish, gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Veggie Pad Thai Box
recipes.summary: Rice noodles stir-fried with egg, tofu and vegetables in a tamarind sauce, topped with peanuts.
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes until pliable and drain.
Fry the tofu in the oil for 5 minutes until golden, push aside and scramble in the eggs until fully set.
Add the carrot, noodles, soy sauce, tamarind and sugar and toss for 3 minutes until the noodles are tender and coated.
Fold in the beansprouts and spring onion and top with peanuts and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites and yolks are fully set. For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C and eat within 24 hours.
Contains egg, peanuts and soy.

recipes.title: Hoisin Tofu Rice Paper Rolls
recipes.summary: Glazed tofu, crunchy vegetables and herbs in fresh rice paper rolls with a lime dip.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil with the hoisin for 6 minutes until sticky and golden.
Soften one wrapper at a time in warm water and layer lettuce, tofu, carrot, cucumber and mint.
Roll up tightly, tucking in the sides, until each roll is firm.
Stir the soy sauce, lime juice and sugar for dipping.
notes: Eat within 24 hours; keep covered and chilled.
Contains soy and sulphites; check the hoisin label for gluten.

recipes.title: Chickpea Frittata Wedges (Vegan, Besan)
recipes.summary: An egg-free frittata of chickpea flour, spinach and onion baked until set, great cold.
steps: Whisk the besan, water, cumin, turmeric and salt into a smooth batter.
Soften the onion in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 4 minutes, add the spinach and tomato until wilted.
Pour in the batter and scatter the coriander, then bake at 200C for 20 minutes until set and golden.
Cool slightly and cut into wedges.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge and can be eaten cold.
Contains no gluten ingredients; check the besan label.

recipes.title: Paneer Bhurji Wrap
recipes.summary: Crumbled paneer scrambled with onion, tomato and spices, rolled in a warm roti.
steps: Soften the onion and chilli in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the cumin and turmeric.
Add the tomato and cook for 3 minutes until pulpy, then stir in the paneer and garam masala for 3 minutes until heated through.
Stir through the coriander.
Warm the roti, spread with the yoghurt, add the bhurji and roll.
notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge; reheat until steaming hot.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Aloo Tikki Burger
recipes.summary: Spiced potato patties pan-fried until crisp and served in a bun with mint yoghurt and onion.
steps: Boil the potato for 12 minutes until tender, drain and mash with the peas, cumin, garam masala, chilli, coriander, flour and salt.
Shape into 2 thick patties.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 5 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Mix the yoghurt and mint, then fill the buns with patties, yoghurt and onion.
notes: Patties keep 3 days in the fridge; reheat until steaming hot.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Egg Curry Wrap
recipes.summary: Hard-boiled eggs in a spiced tomato masala, rolled in a roti with cucumber.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until hard-set, cool in cold water and peel.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil for 6 minutes, add the spices, then the tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes until thick.
Halve the eggs and warm them in the sauce for 2 minutes.
Fill the roti with the egg curry, cucumber and coriander and roll.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites and yolks are fully set. For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C and eat within 24 hours.
Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Kale and Bean Quesadilla
recipes.summary: Crisp tortillas of white beans, kale and cheese, cooked in a pan until melted.
steps: Wilt the kale and garlic in the oil for 3 minutes until soft, then mash in the beans and cumin.
Spread over 2 tortillas, scatter the mozzarella and top with the remaining tortillas.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes each side until golden and the cheese has melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.
notes: Best eaten warm; keeps 2 days in the fridge.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Chicken Banh Mi Rolls
recipes.summary: Pulled chicken with pickled carrot, cucumber, coriander and chilli mayo in a crisp roll.
steps: Toss the carrot with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt for the pickle.
Mix the mayonnaise and sriracha.
Split the baguettes and spread with the chilli mayo.
Fill with chicken, pickled carrot, cucumber, coriander and chilli until generously packed, then press the roll closed.
notes: Food safety: cook use chicken cooked to 75°C and chilled promptly until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Keep below 5C and eat within 4 hours if packed, or within 24 hours with an ice pack.
Contains gluten and egg.

recipes.title: Tuna Onigiri Bento (with Cucumber and Egg)
recipes.summary: Rice balls with tuna mayo and nori, a rolled egg and cucumber, packed in a lunch box.
steps: Simmer the rice with 1.5 cups water, covered, for 12 minutes until tender, then stir through the vinegar and cool.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise and shape the rice around spoonfuls of it into 4 balls, wrapping each in nori.
Beat the eggs with the soy sauce and cook in the oil in a small pan for 3 minutes until fully set, then roll and slice.
Pack the onigiri, egg and cucumber into a lunch box.
notes: Food safety: cook canned tuna only from a freshly opened can until steaming hot and no longer pink in the middle (poultry and mince to 75°C, pork to 70°C). For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C or with an ice pack, and eat within 3 days from the fridge (reheat until steaming hot, once only). Cook the egg until fully set; keep the box below 5C and eat within 24 hours. Cool rice within 1 hour.
Contains fish, egg and soy.

recipes.title: Smoky Tofu Rice Bowl (Budget Lunch)
recipes.summary: Paprika-roasted tofu on rice with sweetcorn and shredded cabbage, for very little money.
steps: Toss the tofu with the oil, paprika and soy sauce and roast at 220C for 25 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Simmer the rice with 1 cup water, covered, for 12 minutes until tender.
Warm the corn in a pan for 3 minutes.
Serve the rice topped with tofu, corn, cabbage, lime juice and spring onion.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge; reheat until steaming hot.
Contains soy.

recipes.title: Egg and Potato Curry Roll (Budget Lunch)
recipes.summary: Soft roti rolled around a mild potato and egg curry with peas.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until hard-set, cool and peel.
Soften the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the curry powder, then the potato, tomatoes and 1/2 cup water and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender.
Add the peas and halved eggs and heat for 3 minutes.
Fill the roti with the curry and coriander and roll.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites and yolks are fully set. For packed lunches chill within 1 hour, keep below 5C and eat within 24 hours.
Contains gluten and egg.
